data.long_meaning: Bhoomija is the Sanskrit word for 'earth' or 'goddess of the earth'. In Hindu mythology, she is the wife of Lord Vishnu and the mother of all living beings. She is also known as Prithvi Devi and is revered for her nurturing and protective qualities. The name Bhoomija carries the meaning “Earth goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi.
